title: Working beside Hunt's CIA colleague Arthur Hawkberg in Queens
place_text: Queens, New York; Robert Mullen Corporation, Washington, DC

tellings.quote: turns out to have been EH Howard Hunt's colleague at the the front that they worked for in Washington, DC.

plain: An author who writes about intelligence history, Peter Levenda, says that around 1979 and 1980 he worked in Queens, New York, alongside a man named Arthur Hawkberg. Levenda says he later learned Hawkberg had been a colleague of E. Howard Hunt, a CIA officer, at a front company called the Robert Mullen Corporation in Washington, DC. He tells it as an example of how close he came to the secret world without knowing it.
